title: Jousting Scoring
content: A knight is awarded three points for shattering a lance on the opponent's shield or torso. Striking the opponent's helm awards five points. Unhorsing an opponent is an instant victory for the tilt.

title: Melee Weapons
content: All weapons used in the grand melee must be blunted. Morningstars and flails are strictly prohibited. Any knight striking a yielding opponent will be disqualified and forfeit their armor.
